name: Majirori! ~Shokushu de H de Hakudaku Mamire~
original_name: まじろりっ!～触手でHで白濁まみれ～
source:
Town gets targeted by a devil. Little girl receives a magic wand and confronts the villain and his tentacle beasts. The fate of this town is entrusted to a little girl.
